items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: We had some good head arrangements, Joe Keyes was in there, very good trumpet player.

ctx.x: Did he get mad at you?

Ben? No, because see he knew what I was doing. He'd try to tell Blanche and Blanche would say, 'well, you know this is my band and if you don't like it, you know, there's somebody around the corner that'll take your place,' you know. And one of those things. But we were all together for a long while, but all in all it was a good band when they'd really get down and play. We had some good head arrangements, Joe Keyes was in there, very good trumpet player.
You were with her for a couple of years, right?
